scope.reachability: All current Git refs via git rev-list --all; commits and trees read as metadata only.
scope.content: Unique reachable allowlisted code/document blobs; all commit-tree path aliases checked before content access.
limitations: Only private-key headers and listed common credential prefixes; a match is a candidate, not validated credential status.
Excluded raw/processed research data, results/individual outputs, local ignored assets, private author packages, local source configurations and original-input inventories.
CSV/TSV, archives, binary and non-allowlisted extensions are excluded; UTF-8 text only, with NUL/non-UTF-8 blobs skipped.
No scan of working-tree raw/processed CTRP responses, indices, individual predictions, ignored local assets, Git reflog-only/unreachable objects, remote-only refs, LFS payloads, or archive contents.
No network request, credential validation, data/model execution, deletion, or Git-history rewrite was performed.
This bounded scan cannot provide a complete absence-of-secrets guarantee.
